title: Only finitely many unit lattice faces meet a compact set (parent step 5)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact. Consider index pairs p = (ι, b) with ι : Fin k → Fin P arbitrary (not necessarily injective) and b ∈ ℤ^P. Only finitely many of them have Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} ∈ K for some y in the closed unit cube [0,1]^k. In Lean, the set {p | ∃ y : Euclid k, (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) ∧ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) 1 ∈ K} is finite.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → {p : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) | ∃ y : Euclid k, (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) ∧ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ) ∈ K}.Finite
